desc: Ideate algorithm: reduce the problem to union coverage of axis-aligned segments via per-line interval merging.

Implement a single compact Python 3 program: parse input, simulate moves, collect closed intervals by fixed coordinate, merge intervals per line, query each house with bisect, count once, print final position and count.
Verify edge cases: endpoints, overlapping/touching intervals, houses on both orientations, large/negative coordinates, and lines with no segments.
